verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Simba ODBC and JDBC drivers that connect applications to BigQuery so users can work with their preferred tooling, which covers the standard-driver core of the story. The only sign of a BI-tool integration is community discussion of a Sheets integration backed by BigQuery. missing for 10: first-party documentation of named BI-tool integrations (e.g., dashboard/BI connectors), hands-on or independent corroboration that dashboards connect via the drivers without custom glue.
